description: This script contains helper functions for creating and managing multiple git packs, including generating dummy pack data and configuring git settings to prevent automatic garbage collection and repacking.

methods.name: create_packs
methods.description: Creates a specified number of dummy git packs with a single blob each, using Perl to generate pack data and piping it into 'git fast-import'.

methods.name: setup_many_packs
methods.description: Configures git settings to disable automatic garbage collection and pack limits, then creates 500 dummy packs.
